Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 11 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Super Typhoon NANDO
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 23 September 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Pampanga, Zambales and Bulacan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna and Quezon within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac(Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas, Bamban, Concepcion, Tarlac City, La Paz) and Nueva Ecija(Gapan, San Isidro, Cabiao, San Antonio) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text: During a raid on Manila Bay in World War II, U.S. Navy gunner Loyce Edward Deen (23 years old) was killed when his TBM Avenger torpedo bomber was hit by Japanese anti-aircraft fire. His body was too badly mangled to be removed from the aircraft's rear turret, so the crew of the USS Essex pushed the damaged plane, with Deen's body inside, overboard to bury him at sea. This tragic event marks the only known burial of an airman in his aircraft at sea in U.S. Navy history.
